Chapter 1204 - 20: Golden Mist (Request For Subscription)

Chapter 1204: Chapter 20: Golden Mist (Request for Subscription)

"Galaxy, your strength?"

Red Flame Venerable looked at Lin Yuan, waves surging in his heart.

Before opening his mouth to inquire, he had already speculated that it was Lin Yuan clashing with the Spirit Prison Venerable.

After all, that kind of intense Fierce Sun aura couldn’t be faked; it was definitely the strength of a Fierce Sun Ancient Country elite, and at that time in that area, only Lin Yuan came from the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

Though the possibility seemed incredibly implausible, is the Galaxy Venerate a top Peak Venerable? Yet, it was the only possibility.

"Not long ago, there was a breakthrough," Lin Yuan said.

This was also the truth. If he hadn’t condensed the crucial Seed of the Fierce Sun, forming a great circulation of Fierce Sun within, letting his strength change qualitatively.

Lin Yuan at most would be at the same level as the Red Lotus Venerable.

After all, Lin Yuan’s real life level currently was merely at the Dominion realm.

Under the premise of not crossing major realms, it was difficult to suddenly go from a Peak Venerable to a top Peak Venerable.

"Hahaha, good, good, good!"

Venerable Guanglie laughed heartily, looking at Lin Yuan full of admiration: "With you, Galaxy Venerate, now our Fierce Sun Ancient Country has four top Peak Venerables, and our means to compete for refining the core pillar are more."

The top Peak Venerables of the major Ancient Countries surely exceed four, but most top Peak Venerables, even the strongest Peak Venerables, are in seclusion, attempting to break through to the thirteenth stage. As for contending for the newly emerged treasure grounds? It’s hard to attract these Peak Venerables.

And the Fierce Sun Ancient Country can only deploy at any time three top Peak Venerables, namely Red Flame, Guanglie, and Hengyang.

Other Ancient Countries are similar; only the Da Fu Ancient Country has slightly more.

The Fierce Sun Ancient Country having an additional top Peak Venerable definitely enhances its foundation, perhaps not clear in the early stages, but in the later stages, when struggling against other Ancient Countries, it will be greatly useful.

"The Galaxy Venerate being able to shatter the Spirit Prison Venerate’s right-eye prison, in terms of killing power, is considered strong among top Peak Venerables."

Venerable Hengyang contemplated as he looked at Lin Yuan.

He had clashed with Spirit Prison Venerate, clear on the other party’s methods, even if he underestimated Lin Yuan, capturing him in the right-eye prison, to shatter it? Still very difficult.

Unless the instant killing power exceeds the limit of what the prison can bear, or else any delay would allow the Spirit Prison Venerate the opportunity to eject Lin Yuan from within.

"It was fortunate," Lin Yuan said.

"Hahaha, the stronger the Galaxy Venerate, the more favorable for us in competing for the treasure ground," Red Flame Venerable smiled.

He never expected that Lin Yuan, whom the emperor had inserted, would bring him such a surprise.

The other Peak Venerables looked at Lin Yuan with complex expressions. Originally, Lin Yuan was on the same level as them; now he is a top Peak Venerable?

"Galaxy Venerate... Was I evenly matched with him in sparring?"

Red Lotus Venerable looked at Lin Yuan, his mind filled with thoughts.

Not long ago, he had sparred with Lin Yuan, then still amazed at the Galaxy Venerate’s strength.

Yet how long had passed, now it was tough to spar with, even defending oneself against the Galaxy Venerate was considered fortunate.

"That core pillar of the treasure ground is close to complete refinement," Lin Yuan looked towards Red Flame Venerable, Venerable Hengyang, and Venerable Guanglie, and said.

According to the initial plan, all discovered core pillars of the treasure grounds should best be refined by the top Peak Venerables.

As for the other Peak Venerables, they primarily focused on guarding the core pillars of the treasure grounds.

"Since you, Galaxy, are also a top Peak Venerable, any discovered core pillar of the treasure ground can also be refined by yourself," Red Flame Venerable nodded and said.

"Alright."

Lin Yuan slightly stirred his mind.

The true body located before the core pillar immediately refined the remaining section of the pillar completely.

Buzz.

At the moment of refinement.

Lin Yuan faintly established a connection with this core pillar.

"Now, as long as I’m within this treasure ground range, I can instantly arrive at this core pillar’s side?" Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Red Flame Venerable and others formulated the plan for top Peak Venerables to refine the core pillars based on this ability.

With the strongest power as top Peak Venerables, them refining the core pillars enabled them to instantly arrive beside any core pillar, greatly maximizing the protection of the pillar.

Of course, this instant arrival must be under stable time-space conditions; if engaged in fierce battle with other powerhouses and the surrounding time and space collapses, using the core pillar to escape or arrive would be impossible.

Earlier, the Spirit Prison Venerate leading numerous Peak Venerables in exploring the core pillars, was also for those Peak Venerables to refine the outer area of core pillars, leaving the deepest section for himself to refine.

Thus, achieving the highest efficiency.

"Simultaneously, I can feel this treasure ground’s suppression on me lessened somewhat," Lin Yuan looked around.

Completely refining this core pillar made him detect numerous changes, originally Divine Ability ’World’ could only meticulously probe within a hundred billion miles range around.

But now, the probing range has increased by approximately ten percent.

This probing is in-depth, capable of discovering the type of core pillar probing.

It can be assumed that the more core pillars refined, the larger the probing range.

...

Da Ling Capital.

A projection of the Spirit Prison Venerate sat here.

The other eleven figures looked incredulously at the Spirit Prison Venerate.

"Spirit Prison, you’re saying it was the Galaxy Venerate from the Fierce Sun Ancient Country who fought with you? Not one of the Red Flame Venerable, Venerable Guanglie, or Venerable Hengyang?"

Linggan Venerable Sage frowned deeply, originally thinking it was one from the Red Flame Venerable trio who acted.

He hadn’t expected it to be Galaxy Venerate. Linggan Venerable Sage never considered Galaxy Venerate noteworthy, despite being a Venerate of the first ancestral bloodline, the growth time was too short.

"Yes."

"That Galaxy Venerate is a top Peak Venerable."

Spirit Prison Venerate confirmed, "My right-eye prison was destroyed by that Galaxy Venerate, leaving my strength no longer at its peak."

"What should we do then?"

The third top-tier Peak Venerable asked.

Spirit Prison Venerable is crucial to our quest for the treasure grounds. By trapping many Peak Venerables in the Spirit Prison, it weakens the ancient countries’ ability to search for the core Galactic Pillars, indirectly increasing Da Ling Ancient Country’s chances of finding more core pillars.

"I plan to use that rare artifact to quickly restore my right eye Spirit Prison."

Spirit Prison Venerable pondered for a moment and said in a low voice.

"That rare artifact?"

Linggan Venerable Sage’s expression slightly changed.

The twelve Peak Venerables of Da Ling Ancient Country carried some heritage rare artifacts bestowed by the ancient countries before entering the treasure grounds.

These heritage rare artifacts are extremely precious and must not be used unless absolutely necessary.

But now?

Spirit Prison Venerable’s right eye was damaged, greatly reducing the efficiency of Da Ling Ancient Country’s search for the core Galactic Pillars.

"Very well then."

"As long as Spirit Prison quickly recovers, using up those rare artifacts is worthwhile."

Linggan Venerable Sage said cautiously, slowly.

If the time to compete for the treasure grounds wasn’t so tight, just two thousand years.

Spirit Prison Venerable would not have the opportunity to use that rare artifact. If his right eye Spirit Prison collapsed? It could slowly recover.

...

As time passed.

The news about Galaxy Venerate being a top-tier Peak Venerable quickly spread among the Peak Venerables within the treasure grounds.

It couldn’t be concealed, after all, there are only a dozen or twenty top-tier Peak Venerables, making it easy to pinpoint a specific range, and Da Ling Ancient Country had no intention of hiding it either.

"Galaxy Venerate? The first aristocrat to elevate the bloodline to the Venerate level?"

In the Da Fu Ancient Country, Fu Xu Venerate, dressed in dark robes, fell into contemplation.

He wasn’t very interested in Lin Yuan reaching top-tier Peak Venerable strength, but valued the supreme ancestor bloodline at the Venerate level more.

"Even with your strength, Fu Xu, even if Galaxy grows to the limit, he might not be a match for you."

Beside him, a top-tier Peak Venerable spoke.

Fu Xu Venerate had already trained one of the highest legacies left by the ancestor to a deep level, his strength was formidable. Not saying the six ancient countries’ history’s strongest, but among the strongest few.

The six ancient countries have been passed down through endless ages, and even within the oldest Da Fu Ancient Country, in the Venerate level ranks, Fu Xu Venerate almost stood at the summit.

Beyond that involves the power of the thirteenth tier.

"It’s uncertain, after all, it’s the ancestral bloodline. Who knows if there might be some evolution in the future."

Fu Xu Venerate smiled slightly, speaking casually.

"Evolution?"

The top-tier Peak Venerable from Da Fu Ancient Country raised an eyebrow, although he didn’t quite agree, he didn’t refute either.

Since it involved the ancestral bloodline, related to the supreme ancestors, even if the source of Galaxy Venerate’s ancestral bloodline was not Da Fu Ancestor, but Fierce Sun Ancestor.

But discussing ancestors is forbidden, it’s a strict rule.

"Alright, let’s quickly search for the core Galactic Pillars."

Fu Xu Venerate said calmly.

"Yes."

The top-tier Peak Venerable from Da Fu nodded.

...

"Galaxy, his strength?"

In the capital of Fierce Sun Ancient Country, the imperial palace.

The emperor also received this news, shocked by Lin Yuan’s strength.

The emperor knew his own affairs well, he was clear that Lin Yuan, decades or even centuries ago, wasn’t even a Venerate.

Yet now he suddenly stepped into the top-tier Peak Venerable realm?

"Fortunately... fortunately..."

The emperor of Fierce Sun Ancient Country murmured to himself, fortunate that back then he was rather good to Lin Yuan, effectively drawing him over.

...

Inside the treasure grounds.

After Lin Yuan refined that core Galactic Pillar, he left a few avatars to guard it, while his true self continued to search in another direction.

"Hmm?"

Suddenly, Lin Yuan stopped, looking towards a certain direction. There was a valley from which golden mist seemed to flow faintly.

Whoosh!

Lin Yuan stepped forward, arriving outside the valley, gazing at the golden mist flowing within.

"The mist within the valley, is it the rare treasure birthed by this treasure ground?"

Lin Yuan pondered to himself, the aura of the golden mist faintly connected to the entire treasure ground, resembling a fruit on a tree, filled with a peculiar energy.

"Let me see..."

Lin Yuan extended his right hand, gathered a wisp of golden mist, and began to observe it closely.

Every first-class treasure ground births rare treasures with different effects, like Hei Yu from Hei Yu Nest that enhances mental willpower, or the Infinite Crystal from the Infinite Eye that grants the Infinite Divine Body.

"This mist..."

Lin Yuan observed intently, his expression gradually shifting.
